correctness.rationale: The no-inversions row action fixes every face vertex whenever it stabilizes a face, because columns are distinct, giving cellular orbit counts (n,C(n,2),2C(n,3),2C(n,4)). A4 is transitive on ordered one/two-row injections and has two parity orbits on triples/quads. Both triangle orbits have standard edge boundary, making the quotient 2-skeleton contain the complete-graph simplex 2-skeleton and π1=0. The integral ker ∂2 splits into negative-positive triangle differences δ_abc and positive tetrahedron cycles w_0ijk. The two signed 3-cell boundaries ∂F+ = w_abcd+δ_bcd+δ_abd and ∂F−=w_abcd−δ_acd−δ_abc permit unit eliminations with z_ij=δ_0ij, leaving one relation ∑_{pairs in any 4-subset}z_pair=0. Thus H2 is integer coker W_(2,4)(n−1), not just a rational rank identity. Wilson inclusion-matrix diagonal-form theorem (full lawful Ghorbani et al. reproof, Corollary 3) applies for v=n−1≥6 and yields factors 6 once, 3 with multiplicity v−1, others units. H3 follows by Euler characteristic and freeness of kernel of top boundary. Independent reconstruction of inclusion matrices v=6 and v=7 gave exact Smith factors [3×5,6] and [3×6,6] respectively; finite tests corroborate, while the all-size claim relies on the symbolic elimination plus general theorem.

final_claim: For every n≥7 the ordinary geometric alternating-row quotient |Δ_(4,n)|/A4 is simply connected, has H2 ≅ Z/6 ⊕ (Z/3)^(n−2), H3 free of rank 1−n+C(n,2)−2C(n,3)+2C(n,4), and zero other positive integral homology. This is a uniform unbounded torsion theorem, not a homotopy-wedge classification.
